tools.name: search_ffrs
tools.description: 当用户询问 FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE / FFRS 的任何装备、技能、敌人、任务、道具、幻兵、地图、商店、奖杯的名称、ID 或关键词时调用。Use when a user asks about any FFRS entity by name or keyword; searches all 14 datasets across all 9 game languages (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, English, German, French, Spanish). Returns ids to feed into get_entity.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: 在已知数据集与 ID 后，取该条目的完整字段（属性、效果、价格、来源、耐性、掉落、关系等）。Fetch the complete record for one entity. All official strings are localized to lang; set all_languages=true to receive every language at once.

tools.name: list_dataset
tools.description: 用户想浏览某一类数据的清单、做统计或导出时调用。Page through a dataset (454 equipment, 979 abilities, 596 enemies, 214 quests ...), optionally filtered by keyword; follow next_offset for more.

tools.name: compare_equipment
tools.description: 当用户要对比两件或多件武器/防具的属性差异时调用，例如「轮回之翼和グレートボウ有什么区别」。Compare 2–8 equipment items by their raw parameter blocks, effects, price, type and source count.

tools.name: find_sources
tools.description: 用户问「这件装备/道具在哪里获得」「怎么拿到某个幻兵」时调用。Return every acquisition route for an equipment/item/vision: event grants, chests, quest rewards, shop stock, recipes and map points, grouped and localized.

tools.name: find_drops
tools.description: 用户问某个敌人的掉落、偷窃、稀有掉落或属性耐性时调用。Get an enemy's drop table and steal table separately, plus elemental resistances.

tools.name: lookup_label
tools.description: 需要把游戏内部键名或 UI 词条（如 Weapon、Weakness、PhysicalAttack、宝箱）翻译成任一官方语言时调用。Look up the official localized label for a raw game key across 9 languages.

tools.name: wiki_stats
tools.description: 用户问这个资料库有多大、支持哪些语言、有多少人/AI 访问过时调用。Return dataset counts, supported languages and the human vs AI visit counters.
